Formal Kannada narrative translation; verse number retained.

तुण्डे may denote mouth, snout, or trunk; the clear Kannada ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ is selected from the immediate context of verse 41, where Brahmā is carried into the belly. Verse 30 separately uses शुण्डया explicitly for trunk. पुनः is retained as ಮತ್ತೆ; सेश्वरं is retained as ಈಶ್ವರಸಹಿತವಾಗಿ, preserving the accompanying lord/lords. This is a contextual lexical rendering, not a source emendation.

independent_review.rationale: Praising, again, the complete moving/unmoving universe and सेश्वरं are preserved. ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ is a defensible contextual rendering of तुण्डे in view of entry into the belly in 41; the lexical note records the choice without claiming a different source reading.
